data.content_ref: inline:SRC_006's claim of 300 pages and SRC_003's claim of 297 pages contradict each other, because both derive from an identical 792-digit budget and an identical 189-digit sub-allocation yet obtain different totals; the contradiction is refuted if one of the artifacts silently changed the premise (e.g., SRC_003 actually computed a different total such as 300) so that the two claims are merely verbally distinct rather than numerically inconsistent.
